# Monaghan County Council

> Official local government portal for County Monaghan providing comprehensive council services, permits, housing, environmental management, and community development programs.

Monaghan County Council (Comhairle Contae Mhuineacháin) serves residents and businesses across County Monaghan, Ireland, offering essential public services ranging from housing and finance to arts, heritage, and environmental protection. The council operates multiple municipal districts and provides integrated digital access to applications, licensing, and community resources.

## Key Topics

- Monaghan County Council
- Local Government
- Housing Services
- Environmental Management

## Emergency & Safety Services

- [Emergency Updates](https://monaghan.ie/emergency-updates): Emergency alerts, crisis information and public safety updates
- [Fire, Civil Protection & Building Control](https://monaghan.ie/firebuildingcontrol): Fire services, building control and civil protection for County Monaghan

## Housing & Community Services

- [Housing](https://monaghan.ie/housing): Social housing, homeless services and housing grants in County Monaghan
- [Community Development](https://monaghan.ie/communitydevelopment): Community development grants, funding and engagement programs

## Business & Economic Development

- [Business](https://monaghan.ie/business): Business support, SME resources and entrepreneurship services in Monaghan
- [Monaghan County Council Launches Summer Internship to the USA in Collaboration with Project Children](https://monaghan.ie/monaghan-county-council-launches-summer-internship-to-the-usa-in-collaboration-with-project-children): Summer internship opportunity in USA with Project Children for Monaghan students

## Environment & Sustainability

- [Environment Home](https://monaghan.ie/environment): Environmental services including waste, pollution, water and food safety
- [Climate Action](https://monaghan.ie/climate-action): Climate Action Unit programs and environmental policy for County Monaghan
- [Biodiversity](https://monaghan.ie/biodiversity): Biodiversity officer and County Monaghan Biodiversity Action Plan
- [Dog Control](https://monaghan.ie/environment/dog-control): Dog control, licensing, welfare and pound services in County Monaghan

## Arts, Culture & Heritage

- [Arts](https://monaghan.ie/arts): Arts Office services, funding opportunities, festivals and artist studios
- [Heritage](https://monaghan.ie/heritage): Heritage office, cultural heritage plans and funding grants

## Finance, Administration & Services

- [Apply](https://monaghan.ie/apply): Application forms for council services including permits, licensing, waste
- [Finance](https://monaghan.ie/finance): Finance department for rates payment and development contributions
- [Motor Tax Office](https://monaghan.ie/motortax): Vehicle licensing, motor tax payment and vehicle registration services
- [Corporate Services](https://monaghan.ie/corporateservices): Council administration, FOI, data protection and compliance services
- [Human Resources](https://monaghan.ie/humanresources): Recruitment, job vacancies and staff development at council

## Library, Culture & Council Structure

- [Monaghan County Libraries](https://monaghan.ie/library): County library services, e-library, genealogy and local history resources
- [Municipal Districts](https://monaghan.ie/municipal-districts): Municipal districts structure, contacts and electoral areas of council
